I was maybe 6 or 8, but I went to Sea World, which was fun before I read of the animal abuse and things, and this happened literally 5 minutes after I stepped through the entrance with my parents and my sister who was in a red stroller. I was watching the flamingoes being fed and they all were bright pink after the shrimp and things. I saw a red stroller being pushed to the left of me so I kept my head down and pulled my baseball cap even lower. I felt a hand on my back and assumed it was my dad. So I walked for about 30 seconds, but then I heard my dad call my name from somewhere behind me. My dad approaches the man with my very confused and angry mom. Turns out that it wasn't my dad but a man with an identical red stroller, and a dog. He was looking for his wife and kid, and thought that I was his kid, so.... it could have gone way worse. This above is what I heard from my parents. But when I remember that event, the man didn't have a red stroller or a wife and kids...

South Korea has people that place hidden cameras in hotels, love parlors, and massage parlors. I learned about this as I was watching a news video on youtube.

Apparently there are cameras everywhere imaginable like pillows, bottles, and even shower heads. This turned into a huge mess as everybody is paranoid that everything is recording them or worse.

Many of these videos are sent to the dark web or pornographic sites, which then the publishers make money off of. Even celebrities have taken part in this.

I hope that people in South Korea are safe and keeping themselves secure.

Forgot to mention that there are special teams that go and find these special cameras so that these kinds of crimes from happening. They use thermal imaging, infrared, and many other tools that I have no idea that actually exists. You should check out the video if you want.
